## Primary ticket and reason

Link the primary ticket and explain why this change is needed. Link related
tickets here; use closing keywords only for verified completion.

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior or documentation change. Link the
issue; use a closing keyword only when its acceptance criteria are satisfied.

## Verification and review

List checks actually run and results. State when no runtime, UI check, or CI applies.

Every PR requires a separate independent review agent/session before merge.
Record the reviewer, outcome, and exact final reviewed commit SHA here or in a
linked PR comment. The author fixes findings; the reviewer rechecks new commits.
Author self-review and CI results do not replace this independent review.

## Remaining limits

Record meaningful follow-up work, pending decisions, or blockers. Update the
linked issues, project status, and affected docs; omit this section if unnecessary.
